therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: detection of PSMA-expressing metastatic prostate cancer lesions via PET imaging
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: men with metastatic PSMA positive prostate cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: region-level correct localization rate and patient-level correct detection rate at 4 hours post injection

results.target_engagement_evidence: high correct localization rates (76.67-86.67%) and detection rates (77.19-84.21%) demonstrate effective PSMA targeting
subgroup_findings: Reader 1 achieved highest CLR and CDR at both time points
4-hour imaging showed similar or slightly improved performance compared to 1-hour imaging for most readers
results.dose_information: single injection of 64Cu-PSMA I&T with imaging at 1 hour and 4 hours post injection

context.duration: 24-hour assessment period with imaging at 1 and 4 hours post injection
